name: print-social-red-pixelated-eye-award-poster-with-white-star
title: Fashion award poster in red with a pixel-stepped eye portrait, white star and giant white type
whatItIs: A red poster with a face cropped to the eyes and cut in stepped pixel edges with a red-orange tint, a white six-point star, a small logo and names at the top left and giant white heavy 'AWESOME SPACE © 2025' with 'FASHION AWARD' in a smaller block and a globe icon.
whatItMeans: Loud and contemporary; stepped pixel edges and giant type feel digital and fashion.
techniques: Crop a portrait to the eyes with stepped edges.
Set giant white type across the bottom.
Add a white star as a graphic.

vocabulary.definition: A photo mask with stair-stepped edges.
A six-point star used as a graphic.
